system.description: You are skilled in making and handling impromptu Explosives. You gain a +5 bonus to Mechanics checks to Handle Explosives. In addition, you can spend a Full-Round Action to craft the equivalent of a Frag Grenade from spare parts you have on hand. You must have access to the appropriate supplies, such as an old blaster, a Tool Kit, or materials found inside a hangar bay.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
